description: Plans whose children were all closed before the seeds plan-lifecycle recompute existed (or via paths that skip applyPlanTransitions, e.g. sd plan release) stay stuck in approved/active forever — 12 fully-complete plans sat non-done with every child and parent seed closed. Audit with: sd plan list | grep -v ' done '.
resolution: One-time direct .seeds/plans.jsonl status flip to done (2026-08-01, 12 plans). Preferred over re-running sd close on an already-closed child, which triggers the recompute but rewrites that child's historical closedAt.
